level.description: Athlete level. Never assumed: if null the report says it was NOT PROVIDED.

camera_view.description: Where the camera is relative to the athlete. side_left means the athlete's left side faces the camera. Side views are needed for a definitive straight-leg assessment.

treadmill_speed_kmh.description: Belt speed, or average speed for a measured track segment. Pace and step length are reported ONLY when this is supplied; they are never estimated from the picture.

body_mass_kg.description: Used only to scale the generic nutrition guidance in Section 8.

declared_frame_rate.description: What the operator believes the capture rate was. The report always uses the MEASURED rate from S0 and flags any disagreement.

manual_event_overrides.description: Optional escape hatch. Maps a leg (L or R) to a list of [heel_strike_s, toe_off_s] pairs in seconds. Overrides S4 detection and is recorded as such in the report.
